verdict.rationale: Figma Make is an AI app builder that publishes apps, so a pre-launch security review is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no security scanning or review feature. The 'Review' tab only shows code additions and deletions, which is an adjacent feature. The community post describes users extracting the code themselves to audit it before deployment, which is a user-side workaround, not platform capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live
